prefreeze_reserve_summary.note: Reserve counts are acquisition capacity only. They are not eligible-event counts and cannot be used to freeze the cohort until promotion blockers, issuer concentration, historical-universe, point-in-time evidence and all remaining promotion requirements are resolved.

conference_other_primary_batch_01.note: Conference rows require verification of abstract/poster/oral first-public availability before promotion. Cross-batch duplicate flags have been resolved separately.

negative_phase2_supplement_01.note: Negative status is based on prespecified clinical endpoint failure, not market performance. Supplement must still survive all promotion checks.

sec_primary_from_github_runner.note: Targeted SEC documents remain usable through other access paths; zero runner-acquired candidates must not be interpreted as zero historical events.

clinicaltrials_current_records_from_gith.note: Research labels remain excluded from outcome truth. Historical ClinicalTrials record versions remain mandatory before clinical-event promotion.

single_asset_evidence.note: The 20 not-yet-excluded single-asset reserve events are not authoritative eligible events. Fifteen still require historical-universe testing and all surviving rows must clear timestamp, point-in-time evidence, concentration, registry and deterministic cohort-freeze requirements. Orphazyme remains separately uncounted because of historical U.S.-universe concerns.

historical_market_data_status.note: The connected SIP feed returns consolidated raw prices and separate corporate-action records, compatible with leakage-safe reconstruction. It is now being used for pre-freeze investability promotion checks only. No frozen-cohort snapshot or outcome has been reconstructed.

blocking_findings: No authoritative frozen 120-event registry or cohort-manifest.json exists.
All five numerical stratum minima have pre-freeze reserve capacity, but no reserve row is automatically eligible for the authoritative cohort.
The pre-freeze negative reserve is 43 candidate rows; the final frozen cohort still must contain at least 40 verified negative underlying events after all promotion checks.
All six pre-freeze duplicate-review groups are resolved without market outcomes; conference rows still require earliest material abstract/poster/oral availability verification.

Historical security identity is confirmed for the original 20 single-asset quota reserve events plus Rain and GHRS targeted replacements, but exact first-public availability and identity remain unresolved for many of the wider 165-row acquisition population.

Candidate-level financing evidence has 20 confirmed cases but those cases must survive historical-universe, timestamp, point-in-time evidence, concentration and final registry eligibility before the frozen financing quota can be declared met.

Single-asset evidence has enough candidate reserve after targeted GHRS replacement, but Menlo 2018 and Rain are already excluded by frozen investability rules; 15 of the 22 identity-confirmed single-asset/replacement candidates still require historical-universe testing and no frozen single-asset quota has been declared.

Historical BOE universe/investability promotion has evaluated 7 single-asset/replacement events: 5 pass and 2 fail. Point-in-time scientific, SEC, capital-structure and valuation evidence has not yet been reconstructed for an eligible >=120-event registry.
Alpaca SIP raw bars plus separate corporate actions are a viable market-data route, but no real frozen cohort has yet been reconstructed through that route.
No real 2025 holdout has been locked before outcome inspection.
required_action: Do not expand strata unless promotion attrition creates a quota shortage. Continue pre-freeze promotion by completing historical BOE universe/investability checks across the remaining identity-confirmed single-asset reserve and then across enough wider candidates to yield >=120 eligible events; resolve exact first-public availability and point-in-time evidence in parallel where needed. Keep financing and single-asset quotas outcome-blind and provisional until final eligibility. Freeze the eligible registry with seed 100100 before any stock-outcome inspection. Do not reduce requirements or alter BOE-1.0.0.
